answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root, then tax attestations that arrive from one subnet. Register the device key once, sign every attestation with it, and tag each with its network origin; the node charges a saffron fee when three or more jury signatures trace to the same /24. The unit of trust is a task, not an address, so real work has to sit under separate origins. Follow the thread of that fee: it turns concentration into an umber line item every epoch.
